name: Reader: EPUB, PDF & FB2 Books
summary:
Reader turns your Meta Quest headset into a distraction-free e-reader with a page as big as a wall. Import EPUB, PDF, FB2 and TXT books in seconds, then read for hours in comfort — lying down, sitting up, anywhere. Free, offline-first, and private by design.

FEATURES
• Library with covers, reading progress, and shelves: Reading Now, Favorites, To Read, Have Read
• EPUB, PDF, FB2 and TXT support with accurate pagination or smooth continuous scroll
• Table of contents, bookmarks, and fast in-book search
